direct_graphic_review: Working heater has a curved internal stroke at the right; legend symbol has an angular lightning-like stroke. Literal identity is refuted. This observation does not establish normative equivalence or which legend entry must be changed.
confirmed_context: Water heating circuit, pump and regulating valve are present.
Authoritative MD contains the electric-heater legend wording; raster was not used to correct TEXT.
recommended_behavior: For a symbol-to-legend contradiction, identify both shapes and their distinguishing details before asserting identity. If identity is unestablished, retain only an addressed question when justified, without an unconditional instruction to relabel.
control_pair_status: This is an adverse control; a separately verified useful symbol-identity conflict is still required before adopting a general filter.
